rule: Blank means unverified. A flag never fills a value; it names what is missing and the source that would settle it.

flags.item: No verified market line exists for any Week 10 game. Every market cell on the Own Lines page is blank.
flags.detail: No official NFL line feed exists and no sportsbook price was fetched. Own lines are model expectations only.

flags.item: The community game log used for the historical backtest has no licence file.
flags.detail: GitHub metadata for leesharpe/nfldata reports license = null at retrieval (2026-11-12). The backtest is a research diagnostic, not a publishable performance record, until this is resolved.

flags.item: NFL.com Terms restrict systematic retrieval and commercial use.
flags.detail: Section 1.3: use is limited to 'your own individual non-commercial and informational purposes'; systematic retrieval to create a database is prohibited without written consent. This site therefore stores only verbatim transcriptions of pages it needs for verification, with URLs.

flags.item: Historical bets are priced at an assumed -110.
flags.detail: No vig, no per-book price. Real prices differ by several cents, which is the same order of magnitude as the edge being tested.

flags.item: The community file was missing three 2026 rows that NFL.com shows.
flags.detail: Arizona season totals, AZ@SEA Week 9, LA@AZ Week 10. Reported by scripts/nfl_reconcile.py, not filled in. A documented club-code alias (ARI in the file, AZ on NFL.com) is applied.

flags.item: Only three clubs have an official depth-chart capture (WAS, NYG, DET).
flags.detail: The availability model is therefore a demonstrated method, not a league-wide table. 29 clubs are missing; four of them (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB) are on bye in Week 10 and have no injury rows.

flags.item: No player-prop history or prop prices exist, so prop singles and prop-combo strategies are untestable.
flags.detail: Candidates S5 and S6 are blocked at gate G01 and have no sample.

flags.item: Only 6 of 275 transcribed injury rows carry an explicit game status on the day read.
flags.detail: Practice participation is not a game status. Rows without a status are published with a blank game status.
flags.status: open - resolves when final game statuses are published (Saturday)

flags.item: Bet settlement rules (pushes, ties, stat corrections, voids) are set by each book, not by the NFL.
flags.detail: The 2026 Rulebook settles what happened on the field, not how a bet is graded. No book house rules were captured.

flags.item: A second NFL section was merged (PR #66) while this lab was being built.
flags.detail: The two sections use disjoint files and do not overwrite each other. Readers may see two NFL entry points until an integration session adds one nav link.

flags.item: The full test suite is red on a clean checkout of main (1 failure in tests/assurance/test_audit.py).
flags.detail: Reproduced in a fresh worktree at b41bc81 before any file was added. The stored inventory hash of .gitignore does not match after checkout, likely a newline/attribute artefact. Not caused by, and not fixed by, this session.

flags.item: The model is evaluated on one completed holdout season plus one prior-season check.
flags.detail: Two seasons is enough to show the signal fails; it is not enough to prove a different signal works. The site says so on every results table.
